consulting.title: Robotics & AI Consulting
consulting.description: Expert consulting services to help organizations identify, plan, and implement robotics and AI automation strategies tailored to their specific needs.

offerings.name: Automation Readiness Assessment
offerings.description: We evaluate your current operations, identify automation opportunities, and build a prioritized roadmap for robotic deployment. Includes ROI analysis and technology recommendation.

offerings.name: Solution Architecture & Design
offerings.description: Our engineers design end-to-end robotic solutions — from hardware selection to software integration — ensuring compatibility with your existing systems and workflows.

offerings.name: Proof of Concept (PoC) Development
offerings.description: Rapid prototyping and pilot deployment to validate automation concepts before full-scale rollout. Typically 4-8 weeks from concept to working prototype.

offerings.name: Safety & Compliance Consulting
offerings.description: Guidance on robot safety standards (ISO 13482, ISO 10218, etc.), risk assessment, and certification processes for deploying robots in regulated environments.

engineering_support.title: Engineering & Integration Support
engineering_support.description: Hands-on engineering services for robot deployment, customization, and integration with existing enterprise systems.

offerings.name: System Integration
offerings.description: Integration of our robots with your WMS, ERP, MES, HIS, and other enterprise systems. Custom API development and middleware for seamless data flow.

offerings.name: Custom End-Effector Design
offerings.description: Design and fabrication of custom grippers, tools, and fixtures for specific application requirements. Rapid prototyping with in-house 3D printing and CNC machining.

offerings.name: On-Site Deployment
offerings.description: Our field engineers handle robot installation, commissioning, site mapping, and workflow configuration at your facility. Typical deployment: 1-4 weeks per site.

offerings.name: Ongoing Technical Support
offerings.description: 24/7 technical support with remote diagnostics, on-site service visits, and spare parts management. SLAs from 4-hour response to next-business-day.

training.title: Training & Education Programs
training.description: Comprehensive training programs to upskill your workforce in robotics operation, programming, and maintenance.

programs.name: Robot Operator Training
programs.description: Hands-on training for frontline staff on robot operation, safety procedures, and basic troubleshooting. 2-day program, no prior technical experience required.

programs.name: Robot Programming Certification
programs.description: Learn to program our collaborative robotss using teach-by-demonstration, Python scripting, and ROS 2. Covers path planning, vision integration, and task sequencing.

programs.name: AI & Computer Vision Workshop
programs.description: Deep dive into the AI technologies powering our robots. Learn to train custom object detection models and deploy models to edge devices.

programs.name: Fleet Management Administration
programs.description: Training for system administrators on Chikku Cloud fleet management — robot provisioning, traffic management, analytics, and maintenance scheduling.

programs.name: Train-the-Trainer Program
programs.description: We certify your in-house trainers to deliver operator and basic maintenance training. Includes all training materials, assessments, and ongoing curriculum updates.

maintenance.title: Maintenance & Lifecycle Services
maintenance.description: Ensure your robot fleet operates at peak performance with our comprehensive maintenance and lifecycle management services.

offerings.name: Preventive Maintenance Plans
offerings.description: Scheduled maintenance visits covering mechanical inspection, sensor calibration, software updates, and battery health checks.

offerings.name: Predictive Maintenance
offerings.description: AI-powered monitoring that predicts component wear and potential failures before they occur. Reduces unplanned downtime by up to 80%.

offerings.name: Spare Parts Management
offerings.description: Guaranteed availability of critical spare parts with 24-hour dispatch. Regional depots in Singapore, Tokyo, San Jose, and Munich.

offerings.name: Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS)
offerings.description: Subscription-based robot deployment that includes hardware, software, maintenance, and support in a single monthly fee. No upfront capital expenditure required.

offerings.name: Fleet Refresh & Upgrades
offerings.description: Hardware upgrade programs and trade-in options to keep your fleet current with the latest technology.

custom_development.title: Custom Robot Development
custom_development.description: For unique requirements that off-the-shelf robots cannot address, we offer custom robot design and development services.

offerings.name: Custom Robot Design
offerings.description: Full-cycle custom robot development — from requirements analysis and conceptual design to prototyping, testing, and production.

offerings.name: Application-Specific Software
offerings.description: Custom AI models, computer vision pipelines, and robot behaviors developed for your specific application. Built on Chikku Brain platform.

offerings.name: Prototyping & Small-Batch Production
offerings.description: Rapid prototyping with our in-house manufacturing capabilities. Small-batch production (10-100 units) for pilot programs.
